mentions.description: An idea from allagin for an app similar to Action but focused on repairs such as electronics and cars: clients post a repair request and masters respond with their offers.
mentions.audience: Clients needing electronics or car repairs, and repair masters ('masters') who respond to posted requests with their offers.
mentions.author: allagin

requests.evidence:
I want to make app like action but for repairs, like electronics and cars.

Client posts request and masters respond with their offers.

What you think about that guys?

supporting.summary: MisterMunchkin points out a similar existing site where users post a job and garages submit offers, including auto-submitted offers for routine services like standard servicing.
supporting.excerpt: There is already a site here where you say what your job is and garages submit their offers. They can also auto-submit offers if it’s something routine like a standard service.
supporting.author: MisterMunchkin

supporting.summary: allagin replies that they are from Central Asia and asks for a link to the similar site mentioned.
supporting.excerpt: Hey, Thanks for info. I am from Central Asia, could share a link for that site?
supporting.author: allagin
